lines.en: label sportswars15:
scene newlywedgame1
: You know, we sure have a lot of parties for your typical, run-of-the-mill high school class.
: Yeah. I’m well fucking aware.
scene newlywedgame2
: Yeah, but now you get to be even more aware since you’re actually coming to them with me now!
: Chika, I come to all of them. I just normally don’t stay for more than ten minutes because these “parties” are pretty much just free buffets as far as I’m concerned.
: Well, yeah. Having two girls in the class who are completely loaded and more than willing to have these things catered can sort of do that. But still- I’m glad you’re here.
: Even if I have to leave in like twenty minutes because I have work in the morning and have to feed my sister. You’re staying here though, right?
: After you’re gone? Fuck no. Who else am I gonna talk to?
: Rin and Futaba maybe? You guys did share a near-death experience together earlier today. And that normally creates some sort of trauma bond, doesn’t it?
: Fuck if I know. And fuck if I care. I’m just here to capitalize on the rich girls’ food and then fuck off back to the old apartment where I can go to sleep without anyone attempting to contact me.
scene newlywedgame3
: Well, don’t go capitalizing too hard. We’ve got plenty of mouths to feed and it’s not like Touka’s here to replenish our stores anymore, what with Yasu’s...thing and all.
: Fuck even was that? Looked away for five seconds and turned around to see her on the ground. Which, considering who we’re talkin’ about, wasn’t that weird. But people sure seemed to think it was.
: Touka said it was just a migraine. But I guess it could also be more weird God stuff. You never really know when it comes to Yasu.
: Either way, I imagine she’s just going to take Yasu back home once they’re out of the infirmary.
: And the same probably goes for Miss Watabe as I can’t imagine her wanting a bigger part in the chaos that is our next contest.
: We ain’t even got a clue what the next contest is yet, though. Right? All we’ve got is the fuckin’ name.
: Yeah, but I think that’s enough to start piecing things together. And, any second now, Imani’s probably just going to-
: Okay! Listen up!
: See? What did I just say?
scene newlywedgame4
: We’ve got this venue for a grand total of four hours before all of us get kicked out and the strippers who usually work here get invited back in!
: Why are we having our last two contests in a strip club to begin with?

: Because that’s all I could find, style-thief! Sakaki-bar-a’s gotten too popular lately to host the Dorm Wars. So unless Sana wants to revitalize this place next, this is all we’ve got for the near future.
: I’m not sure if...I have the experience needed to...revitalize a place like this...
: And...I’m also not sure if I had anything to do with the bar being fixed in the first place.

: Then it looks like we’ve got a new secret base! Complete with poles and everything! But please, don’t be afraid to strip away minor details like that as they’ll only complicate what little time we have left!
: Does our next contest involve the shedding of our robes?
: No, I just saw an opportunity to make a pun and jumped on it. The ninth contest of this year’s Dorm Wars will be a lot more simple and likely won’t involve the removal of any clothing.
: Likely?
scene newlywedgame5
: You’re all young and shit, so you’re probably not familiar with the Newlywed Game. But basically, the way it works is that couples face off to see who knows their partner better.

: And the justification I have thought up to permit the inclusion of this game in the Dorm Wars, specifically the sports day variant, is the fact that it requires some form of teamwork. However, there is a twist.
scene newlywedgame6
: You’re all really cliquey and shit. So, if I were to send Rin and Futaba up there against Uta and Io, no new bonds would be formed and no progress would be made.
: Today, despite all of the chaos and turmoil, has ultimately been centered around bringing all of you closer together. And I feel like we’ve accomplished that in a number of ways.
: But the true test comes now- as I’ll be drawing two names at random for each floor and testing their knowledge about one another.
: How close have you studied your classmates? How much of an impression have they left on you? But, most importantly...how will you fare as newlyweds?!
scene newlywedgame7
: Fun, right?!
: I apologize, but I am already married.
: I also apologize, but I will be in the future.
: Hopefully, all of us will be in the future.
: I could get married whenever I want and no one can do anything about it.
: Woo! Great job being independent, Makoto!
: She just means she’s holding a marriage license hostage.
: Since when do you know about that?
: It doesn’t matter. I will find it and destroy it. Mark my words.
: Well, I’m kind of screwed if I have to go up there and guess shit about anyone other than you.
: That fate could have been easily avoided had you only read my book, Otoha. I quite accurately chronicled the inner-workings of all the girls in our class. Sometimes, even the sexual ones.
: Sometimes?
: Why, yes. Not all of them have experience yet, after all. At least not the type that would directly relate to the protagonist of the story.
: And my audience tends to care more about that than information gained through alternate sources.
: For example, simply spilling out traumatic events from a character’s past would serve no purpose other than to-
: Hey, fun idea. How about you don’t give me a lesson on literature inside of a strip club?
scene newlywedgame8
: Would you prefer I strip for you instead?
: No. But I would like to know why you’re wearing a suit. And I wouldn’t mind if you replaced it with something more fitting for this event.
: I have another event to attend after this one — the type one should dress up for. Does that satisfy your curiosity?
: No.
: Well, then. Hopefully this next contest will.
: Aaaaaaand the first girl to be chosen for the Newly-Newlywed Game is Nodoka Nagasawa, because of course it is.
scene newlywedgame9

: Oh, heck yeah! Nodoka’s accurately guessed the color of my underwear every day for the last three months! She knows everything even when nobody tells her! Which is creepy! But in this context, great!
: What can I say? I have super powers.
: You realize you can probably press charges if you have that many instances of sexual harassment from one person, right?
scene newlywedgame10
: Yes, but I don’t want to have to move again.
: What?
: Aaaaand the second girl chosen for this contest is Io Ichimonji! Come on down, you two!
scene newlywedgame11
: Oh?
: Me?! Why me?! I already participated today! I should be exempt from having to do that again!
: She chose the names at random, Io. It’ll be fine.
: No it won’t! I don’t know shit about Nodoka! And it’s not like I want to go up there and guess!
scene newlywedgame12

: Then you’re in luck! Because we only have time for one round from each team if we want to hang out and mingle and stuff. Meaning only one of you will guess answers while the other simply provides them.
: See! I told you it’d be fine. You can literally just stand there and write about all of the stuff you like and dislike on a little tablet. It’s the perfect job for you.
: Uhh, Uta? I think my “perfect job” involves a little less “standing on a stage in front of a crowd of people.”
: Just pretend we’re all in our underwear! Or be like Nodoka and just inherently understand all of our underwear!
: I’m gonna get called for this shit, ain’t I?
: Nah. With our luck, it’ll probably be Maya and we’ll automatically lose the contest since she still isn’t here.
: The first girl competing for the first floor is Yumi Yamaguchi.
scene newlywedgame13
: Or I’m completely wrong.
: God fucking damn it.
: You got this, Yumi!
: Yeah! Just think of all the reasons you avoid us and those will probably be the correct answers!
: On the bright side, you won’t be everyone’s most-hated person up there. All three girls have been pretty divisive so far. And, if it’s any consolation, you’re my favorite out of all of them.
: It’s not.
: Aaaaaaand the last girl chosen to compete is Makoto Miyamura!
scene newlywedgame14
: Fantastic.
: Yumi and me?
: How the heck is this gonna go? Ain’t ever seen you two talk if it ain’t about school stuff or Yumi gettin’ in trouble.
: That’s a good question. Though, I suppose if Miss Imai’s goal really is to force some of us closer together, this is as adequate a pairing as any.
: Adequate my ass, Prez. Only thing I know about you is that you’ve got a hard-on for givin’ me homework.
: Makoto’s like that with everybody. It ain’t just a Yumi thing.
: I barely even do that anymore. And besides, it’s not like I know anything about you either. You rarely speak to anyone at all apart from Chika.
scene black
: Well, that changes now! Because both teams have a total of five minutes to get to know one another and designate positions!
: I would like the bottom bunk. Climbing down from the top isn’t good for my knees.
: And I would like to know where I dropped my cyanide capsule. I could have sworn I had one just a second ago.
: Come on, Yumi. Let’s see how much we can cram into just a few minutes worth of studying time.
: This ain’t the fuckin’ time for learning shit, you dumb-
: Studying things about each other. Context clues, Yumi. Context clues.
: Hah...we’re fucked, aren’t we?
Approximately ten minutes later...
scene newlywedgame15
: Okay! Now that our first batch of contestants has taken the stage, let’s get this show on the road!
: Yumi — you’ve been the one chosen from your team to answer questions about Makoto. But just how well can you do that, I wonder?
: I can't.
: Are you sure you don’t want to swap positions? I feel like my memory might be a bit better than-

: Yeah, I’m fuckin’ sure. You really think I’m gonna go up there and air out my interests after I’ve worked so hard to keep that shit a secret? Nah. Ain’t happenin’. Hit me with the first question, Teach.
: Question one — what is Makoto’s favorite color?
scene newlywedgame16
: Uhh...
: Am I allowed to phone a friend?
: Do you even have any?
: Chika — what’s the Prez’s favorite color?
: I don’t think I’m allowed to answer these questions for you, Yumi.
: This was literally the first thing I told you when I pulled you aside. It’s such a baseline question that I figured it would have to come up eventually.
: Yeah, I wasn’t payin’ attention.
scene newlywedgame17
: Hah...
: I don’t know. Let’s just go with blue.
: No, it’s-
scene newlywedgame18
: Oh.
scene newlywedgame19
: You somehow got it right.
scene newlywedgame20
: Nodoka! In order to make things fair since I’m not convinced you aren’t just a living repository for all information ever, I’ve decided to make your questions a bit harder!
: Please do not handle me too roughly, madam speaker. I break easily.
: Can you maybe cut back on the eye contact a little? Thanks.
: Nodoka, what is Io’s favorite insect in the Saharan desert?
: Is that a fair question? Even I don’t know the answer to that and I live with both Io and a bug.
: It’s Nodoka. I’m sure she knows.
: My gut instinct is to say it’s the Saharan Silver Ant or cataglyphis bombycina as it’s a somewhat reclusive bug that only ventures outside of its burrow for about ten minutes per day, so...
: Saharan silver ant. Final answer.
scene newlywedgame21
: How the fuck did you know that?
: Lucky guess, I suppose.
: Welp! As great as it would be for Nodoka to be wrong about something, the score is now one to one!
scene newlywedgame22
: Yumi!
: Yo.
: What is Makoto’s favorite movie of all time?
: I told you this too. Another very simple question.
: Fuck if I know. Die Hard, maybe?
scene newlywedgame23
: Aaaaand our luck has run out.
: Hey, at least I got the death part right. Ain’t my fault you’d rather watch some poets die than Bruce Willis bein’ a fuckin’ badass.
scene newlywedgame24
: Nodoka! What is Io’s favorite volatile organic compound?
: I would assume it’s ethanol as I believe she spends a fair amount of time woodworking and it’s the most interesting-sounding compound used in wood polish.
scene newlywedgame25
: You’re creepy.
: In a good way or a bad way?
: In a way that makes me not want to play this game anymore. Or even be in the same room with you if you can just read my thoughts like that.
: I’m no “mind-reader.” I’m simply more perceptive than most and have a fair bit of expertise when it comes to interpreting the actions of others.
: And I suppose I’m a tad bit lucky as well as there is always the possibility that I’ll get one of these questions wrong.
: All I’m really doing is picking the most likely answer based on the information I do have.
: Translation: I am very creepy. Thank you for noticing.
: You all give me far too much credit for just being me.
scene newlywedgame26
: Yumi! What is Makoto’s favorite pizza topping?
: It’s pepperoni. Say pepperoni.
: Her favorite pizza topping is knowledge.
scene newlywedgame27
: Incorrect!
: Oh, would you look at that?
: You’re not even trying! I literally handed you the answer on a silver platter that time! Also, knowledge isn’t even tangible! You can’t put it on a pizza!
: Well, I guess now I know that for the future.
: Why are you throwing the competition?! All of these questions have been incredibly easy even if you just learned them!
: Yeah. But if I get more than one right, people will start to think we’re friends. And now that Noriko’s started to claim that, shit’s getting way too busy for me.
: Plus, we’re up against someone who’s guessin’ fuckin’ bugs and chemicals and shit correctly. We ain’t winning this one no matter how badly we want to.
: You wouldn’t know that for sure unless you tried! But we’re so far behind now that we’ll probably never find out, will we?!
: Darn. How will life ever go on after today?
scene black
: AAAAAAAAAAH!
: Nodoka! You’re up next!
Ten minutes and ten questions later...
scene newlywedgame28
: Well, as expected, the score is now twelve to one in favor of the second floor.
: But, even though the outcome of this last question will not change anything even if Nodoka gets it wrong, I’m going to read it anyway because I still want to stump her.
: I’ve been stumped several times, Miss Imai. I’m just very lucky.
: Yeah. Well, let’s see how lucky you are after this one.
scene newlywedgame29
: What is Io’s most precious memory?
scene newlywedgame30
: Her most precious memory?...
: I have accepted that I can not stump you with anything involving actual knowledge, so the only way I can is by smackin’ you upside the head with emotion, feelings, and life experience!
: So! Go ahead, Nodoka! Guess the specific memory this girl you’ve never had a real conversation with holds closest to her heart!
scene newlywedgame31
: You know you can just guess something random at this point, right? We’ve already won. There’s no need to pad the score. That’s like stealing a base when your team’s up 10-0. It’s unnecessary.
: I suppose you’re right- but that does nothing for my curiosity. This is the first question that has actually interested me- and also the only one I have not immediately had an answer for.
: It’s pepperoni. Just say pepperoni.
: No, I don’t think I’ll do that.
: In fact...I’m not sure there is a correct answer to this question. At least not in the sense that would earn me another point.

: And I think that, even if I were to guess correctly, the answer wouldn’t be the same as what you’ve written down as your instinctive response to a request to reveal such information would be to close yourself off.
: Just fucking say pepperoni. Say anything.
: I can’t...because any answer I give would be met with a buzzer.
: All but one, at least.
: I think you left the tablet blank.
: Io! Please reveal your answer!
scene newlywedgame32
: Heh.
: Fuck!
: You can read me as much as you want, Nodoka. It’s not impressive.
: Any therapist could have arrived at that same answer after meeting with me once or twice.
: I would hope so. It’d be rather poor form for a girl my age to be more effective at reading people than trained professionals. I’m just a normal teenager.
: You’re far from normal and you know that.
: You can sit there...and you can smile...and you can pretend you’re not hot shit...But we all know that’s not how you really feel on the inside.

: You think you’re better than us. And, in some ways, you are. I mean, you beat me in everything for sure. But that’s even less impressive than a ten-minute psych-eval. Because I am nothing and that’s obvious.
: I have no “cherished memories.” I’m not just keeping them to myself. That’s why the tablet was blank.
: Is there a problem, Io? You seem rather offended that someone here actually seems to understand you on some level.
: Knowing and understanding are two different things. So you can know as much as you want. But you’ll never really get it, Nodoka. You’ll never understand me the way you’re pretending to right now.
: Would you perhaps like to continue this conversation in private so I may further inquire as to why you think that way about me?
: I’m a very friendly girl, Io. I’d quite enjoy some one-on-one time with you if you’ll have me.
: I’m not interested in making friends. And I’m definitely not interested in “one-on-one” time with you.
: Is that because it’s me specifically? Or would you extend that same rotting olive branch to all of us who were blessed to be born with slits between our legs?
: Aight. Time to wrap things up. That’s enough out of you two.
: Why even ask? It’s not like there’s anything left for you to learn since you apparently already know it all.
: I suppose I don’t need to.

: It’s rather evident based on your actions and tendencies that much of this animosity stems from the fact that you’ve been sexually abused in some way. I’m just trying to figure out if it was family or a friend.
scene newlywedgame33
: Mother, perhaps? If you were young enough, I can see how that would permanently skew your outlook concerning women as a whole. And if you’re that opposed to simply being alone with me-
scene newlywedgame34
: Oh. She’s gone.
: Io! Wait!
scene black
scene newlywedgame35
: Well, that’s a rather unique expression for you.
: I take it you are going to hit me now?
: Why did you do that?
: I intended to ask in private. Unfortunately, it did not seem as if that would ever be an option.
: Are you disappointed in me, Uta-chan?
: I don’t think I’ve ever been this disgusted in my life. And, since you probably already know about me too, that’s saying a lot.
: Perhaps you should try looking at this from my perspective? I-
scene newlywedgame36
: Perhaps you should leave my friend alone!
scene newlywedgame37
: Well, that wasn’t looking at this from my perspective at all.
scene newlywedgame38
: Oh. Hello, Otoha.
: Apologies. I appear to have caused a bit of a disturbance again.
scene newlywedgame39
: Uta didn’t say it, so I will.
: I’m very disappointed in you, Nodoka. You crossed the line and you know it.
: Go home.
: I was simply giving her the opportunity to-
: Now.
scene black
: If that is what must be done, it will be done.
: Ahem. To whom it may concern — this changes nothing.
: I will still be where I said I would be.
: That is all.
